H1.quote: R-4 | Check-out and check-in work without network and sync when the phone is back online. ... records reach the NAS within 5 minutes of reconnect

H2.quote: No third-party cloud: the data stays on the club's own hardware. ... Coach names and phone numbers are personal data under GDPR.

H3.quote: Runs on the club's existing Synology NAS, in Docker. - Costs 0 EUR per month.

H4.quote: R-5 | Every Monday morning the overdue report is e-mailed to the kit manager.

H5.quote: QS-1 ... checks out a bag by scanning its QR code ... at most 3 taps and under 15 seconds, measured with first-time volunteers

H6.quote: R-7 | The treasurer can export the yearly inventory as CSV for the insurance audit.

H7.quote: About 40 coaches and about 300 items. Performance is not a concern.

H8.quote: Maintained by one volunteer who knows Python only; a successor must be able to take it over.

H9.quote: Lost-item history is kept for 2 years, for the insurance.

H10.quote: 30 days before the expiry date of a first-aid bag item, the kit manager is warned. (02-expiry-warning.md)

H11.quote: Out of scope: money. No deposits, fines or payments.

H12.quote: Live for the start of the season on 1 March 2027.
